Each handshake pairs one witch with one sorcerer, and each of the 6 witches shakes hands with all 10 sorcerers. That gives 6 × 10 = 60 handshakes.

Solution A counts the handshakes from the witches' side (60) and from the sorcerers' side (60). These are two counts of the same set of handshakes, not two separate sets. Dividing by 2 is therefore wrong, and its answer of 30 is incorrect. Solution B reaches 60 by both counting methods, which agrees.

WINNER: B
